name: Billing-period toggle
definition: Switch above the plan cards that flips every price between monthly and annual billing and states the annual saving.
bestUse: Subscription pricing that rewards annual commitment.

demo.how: One switch controls every price on the page, so plans stay comparable whichever period the visitor prefers. Choose Monthly or Annual: prices update, annual shows the monthly equivalent with the yearly total underneath, and the saving is stated next to the switch. Prices are illustrative.
